image_description: A white minibus with a dark lower trim, parked on a muddy surface. The vehicle features a high roof, a large front windshield, side windows along the passenger compartment, and standard van wheels. There is visible dirt and mud splatter on the lower body panels.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof van silhouette, distinct from full-size buses, with proportions consistent with a minibus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is clearly visible, and a continuous row of side windows runs along the length of the passenger cabin.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The driver's door is visible at the front, and the overall height relative to the wheelbase suggests a standing-height interior typical of minibuses.
The passenger entrance door is located on the far side of the vehicle (right side) and is not visible in this left-profile view.
The short hood ahead of the windshield indicates a front-engine layout, typical for this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is outside the frame or obscured by the angle; taillights and license plate are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible wheels are proportional to the vehicle size and appear to be standard steel rims with hubcaps.
The window configuration and overall size are consistent with a capacity of approximately 10-15 passengers, fitting the minibus category.

artifact_observations.location: Lower body panels and wheel wells
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mud/dirt texture on the lower half of the bus appears slightly smudged and lacks fine particulate detail, blending into the paint rather than sitting on top of it. This is a minor textural inconsistency common in AI generation but could also be due to image compression.

The front grille slats and headlight integration appear slightly soft and ill-defined. The black bumper trim seems to merge into the white bodywork without a sharp seam, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity.
